chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Anfield, 2025. Liverpool lead two-one, but Bournemouth win the ball. Antoine Semenyo runs from his own half, straight down the middle. Nobody stops him... bottom corner! Two-two!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again. He carries the ball fast into the empty space. The defenders back away and just watch... but he does not wait!

chapters.label: Behind the shot
chapters.text: From behind him: he moves the ball onto his right foot and shoots, low into the bottom corner!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: carry the ball at speed into space. Then shoot before the defender gets back!
